industries.headline: Turn account-opening interest into verified new customers
painPoints: Account-opening and product sign-up campaigns that get expensive on broad ad platforms
Branch staff and partners with real reach but no digital way to earn for referrals
Difficulty proving which channel actually drove a completed account opening

whyCommission.title: Pay per qualified account-opening inquiry
whyCommission.body: Set what a genuine, qualified inquiry is worth to you, and only pay your Campaign Wallet when it happens.

whyCommission.title: Staff and partners can be affiliates too
whyCommission.body: Branch staff, agents, and satisfied customers can share a unique link and earn for referrals that convert.

whyCommission.title: WhatsApp-first follow-up
whyCommission.body: A prospect moves straight from an affiliate's link into a WhatsApp conversation with your team.

industries.exampleUseCase: A bank lists a savings account product on Commission, sets a cost per qualified account-opening inquiry, and lets branch staff and partners share the link across their own networks.

whyCommission.title: WhatsApp-first, matching how property deals actually happen in Nigeria

industries.headline: Fill more HMO enrollments and appointment requests, affordably

No easy way for satisfied patients or partners to refer people who convert

industries.headline: Acquire verified sign-ups without paying for every click

Community-driven audiences (finance Twitter, WhatsApp groups) who are hard to reach through traditional ads

whyCommission.title: Pay for a qualified sign-up, not an impression
whyCommission.body: Set a cost per Intent Qualified Lead that matches your actual unit economics, not an auction price set by competitors.

whyCommission.title: Reach community-driven audiences directly
whyCommission.body: Affiliates already embedded in the communities your product targets can share a link far more naturally than a banner ad.

whyCommission.title: Transparent, automatic attribution
whyCommission.body: Every referral is tracked from the original click through to a qualified conversion.

industries.exampleUseCase: A savings app lists its referral campaign on Commission, sets a cost per qualified sign-up, and lets finance-focused creators and community leaders promote it for a share of that fee.

Difficulty proving which marketing channel actually drove an enrollment

whyCommission.title: Pay per qualified enrollment inquiry
whyCommission.body: Only your Campaign Wallet gets charged once a genuine inquiry is confirmed - not for every visitor.

whyCommission.title: Full funnel, hosted for you

industries.exampleUseCase: An online course provider lists a program on Commission, and tutors who already recommend it to their own students earn a commission for every qualified enrollment inquiry.
